scenes.title: Proposal in the Cafe
scenes.summary: In a busy cafe, Samson hides a gold ring in Nina's pastry and asks her to marry him right away. Nina says no and tells him to take the ring back.

scenes.title: Samson Waits for an Answer
scenes.summary: Nina reminds Samson he is late for football, but he refuses to leave and says he will wait for her answer however long it takes.

scenes.title: Nina Says Yes
scenes.summary: Samson is still waiting in the cold when Nina comes back. She finally says yes to his proposal, and he promises to be the best husband.

scenes.title: How Much Money Does It Take
scenes.summary: A singer performs a song about how much money it takes to be happy, listing villas, yachts and ever more wealth.

scenes.title: Ilona's Unexpected News
scenes.summary: Samson is angry about a photo posted online, and Arkady tells him to calm down. Ilona then arrives with the news that the president is coming to town.

scenes.title: The President's Visit
scenes.summary: Pasha's assistant reports that the president will visit an airfield and meet only Samsonov, not Pasha or the governor. Pasha calls it a catastrophe for his campaign.

scenes.title: Panic at Headquarters
scenes.summary: Pasha angrily orders his staff back to work. He fears the president's visit will give Samsonov a win, while his assistant protests that it is unfair.

scenes.title: Preparing for the Meeting
scenes.summary: Arkady tells a nervous Samson that the president likes simple working people and gives him the program to learn. He urges Samson to pull himself together and keep the meeting secret.

scenes.title: Nina's Anxiety
scenes.summary: Nina tells Danya she is worried because her husband Ivan has not called, which is unlike him. Danya says the silence is good, and she decides to go home and check on him.

scenes.title: Major Lavrov's Report
scenes.summary: Major Lavrov tells General Kruglov that the department is too afraid of risk. The general orders him to write his resignation report, and Lavrov agrees.

scenes.title: Breakfast in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Lev serves Vika breakfast and says he likes cooking and was once married. They chat about marriage and loyalty.

scenes.title: A Couple More
scenes.summary: Vika worries about gaining weight, and Lev tells her people are loved for their kind hearts. She asks for a couple more pancakes, and they agree to drop formal names.

scenes.title: Call Me Vika
scenes.summary: Vika and Lev agree to call each other by first names. She thanks him for being dependable, and he promises to keep her safe and pours more tea.

scenes.title: Diversification
scenes.summary: Arkady drills Samson on the term diversification before his meeting with the president. Samson complains, learns what it means, and repeats it confidently.

scenes.title: Meeting with the President
scenes.summary: Nina visits Samson, who insists he has a secret meeting with the president today. She thinks he is hiding his grief behind bravado and he sends her away.

scenes.title: A Call to Pavel
scenes.summary: Arkady phones Pasha and says he has photos from Pasha's phone. He threatens to give them to the police unless Pasha does what he asks.

scenes.title: Checking the Schedule
scenes.summary: Nina asks Ilona whether Samsonov has an important meeting scheduled. Ilona says there is none, and Nina decides to consult a doctor.

scenes.title: A Visit with Lyolya
scenes.summary: Arkady brings Lyolya to see Marina and tells Marina goodbye forever. Marina threatens to pour milk on him, and her son Danya asks if Uncle Arkady is gone.

scenes.title: Testing Before the Meeting
scenes.summary: Samson tells Lyolya to hide somewhere safe until his call at eight in the evening. If he does not call, she should give the photographs to the police.

scenes.title: Report of Resignation
scenes.summary: Lyova tells Tolya he plans to submit his resignation, but Tolya urges him not to. They find the mayor's visitor log in an old box and think it could help solve the case.

scenes.title: Anikeev's Freedom
scenes.summary: Arkady and Pasha prepare to leave on a private plane in three hours. Pasha says he will show Arkady where the money is hidden.

scenes.title: Before Departure
scenes.summary: Arkady tells a guard to wait outside while he gets his documents. The guard says the car is ready, and Arkady says he is free from house arrest.

scenes.title: An Offer to Leave
scenes.summary: Arkady tells Marina he is leaving the city for good and asks her to come abroad with him. Marina refuses and tells him to go away.

scenes.title: In the Admitting Ward
scenes.summary: An orderly takes Samson into a city hospital, where Samson insists he is healthy and is a candidate for mayor. The orderly tells him to sit and wait for the doctor.

scenes.title: The Calming Medicine
scenes.summary: A paramedic and a doctor prepare a calming injection for a noisy patient. The doctor tells him to use the ampoule from the cabinet and follow the instructions.

scenes.title: Visit to the Clinic
scenes.summary: Pasha is upset the doctor sedated the candidate, who cannot meet the president like this. The doctor offers a caffeine injection and asks them to wait ten minutes.

scenes.title: Inner Resilience
scenes.summary: Samson introduces himself to Major Lavrov and says nothing bad was done to him because he has strong inner resilience. Lavrov warns him not to say anything foolish.

scenes.title: Managing the Staff
scenes.summary: Arkady and Lidia Alexeyevna load money into large bags. Lidia complains about how Pavel treated his staff, and Arkady thanks her for her loyalty.

scenes.title: A Simple Setup
scenes.summary: Pasha tells Arkady that the whole thing was a setup and he is keeping the millions. Arkady threatens to call the police, but Pasha says he has no proof.

scenes.title: Fate Gave Change Back
scenes.summary: Samson tells the former mayor Arkady that fate has paid him back and he must now live simply in the old apartment. Arkady says he will wait for the court decision.

scenes.title: The Ankle Monitor
scenes.summary: Arkady is fitted with an electronic ankle bracelet as he returns to house arrest in the apartment.

scenes.title: Arkady's Breakdown
scenes.summary: Klavdiya Viktorovna mocks Arkady upon his return until he unexpectedly breaks down in tears.

scenes.title: Eduard Looks for Marina
scenes.summary: Drunk and heartbroken, Eduard arrives at the communal apartment looking for Marina, only to find she is with Arkady.

scenes.title: Showdown in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Samsonov furiously confronts Nina and Danya, triggering a fierce quarrel in the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Candidate's Fight
scenes.summary: Nina tells Samson to stop a fight and go home. At home she tells their son Misha that his dad fought again, and Samson says he was defending their honor.

scenes.title: Jedis and Samsonov
scenes.summary: Samson says he has had enough of the Jedis today, and Nina asks Yulia for the first aid kit. They see Samsonov on TV, and Samson asks if the president cancelled the meeting.

scenes.title: Understood, Major
scenes.summary: Lyova reports to General Kruglov that the mayor had a hidden camera in his office. The general refuses Major Lavrov's report and orders the operation to continue.

scenes.title: Colleagues Again
scenes.summary: Major Lavrov and agent Sokolov celebrate being colleagues again after the general tears up Sokolov's report.

scenes.title: Lev Egorych
scenes.summary: Vika flatters Governor Lev, and he asks her to call him simply Lyova. They toast their happiness over wine.

scenes.title: How Much Money Does It Take
scenes.summary: A singer performs a comic song about how much money it takes to be happy, listing villas, yachts and ever more wealth.
